sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Security Service Disabled Via Reg.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" to disable security services such as Windows Defender.
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), John Lambert (idea), elhoim

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: New RUN Key Pointing to Suspicious Folder
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects suspicious new RUN key element pointing to an executable in a suspicious folder
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Sander Wiebing, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Service DACL Abuse To Hide Services Via Sc.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects usage of the "sc.exe" utility adding a new service with special permission seen used by threat actors which makes the service hidden and unremovable.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Disable Windows Defender Functionalities Via Registry Keys
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects when attackers or tools disable Windows Defender functionalities via the Windows registry
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: AlertIQ, Ján Trenčanský, frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Powershell Defender Disable Scan Feature
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects requests to disable Microsoft Defender features using PowerShell commands

values.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true -DisableIOAVProtection $true -DisableScriptScanning $true -DisableBehaviorMonitoring $true -DisableBlockAtFirstSeen $true -MAPSReporting 0 -SubmitSamplesConsent 2 -EnableControlledFolderAccess Disabled -DisableArchiveScanning $true -DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem $true -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Deny Service Access Using Security Descriptor Tampering Via Sc.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications to deny access to a service that affects critical trustees. This can be used to hide services or make them unstoppable.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Reg Add Suspicious Paths
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects when an adversary uses the reg.exe utility to add or modify new keys or subkeys

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Windows Defender Service Disabled - Registry
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects when an attacker or tool disables the  Windows Defender service (WinDefend) via the registry
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Ján Trenčanský, frack113, AlertIQ, Nasreddine Bencherchali

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Suspicious Windows Defender Registry Key Tampering Via Reg.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to tamper with different Windows Defender registry keys in order to disable some important features related to protection and detection
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Disable Windows Defender AV Security Monitoring
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects attackers attempting to disable Windows Defender using Powershell

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Suspicious Windows Service Tampering
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects the usage of binaries such as 'net', 'sc' or 'powershell' in order to stop, pause, disable or delete critical or important Windows services such as AV, Backup, etc. As seen being used in some ransomware scripts
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113 , X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Allow Service Access Using Security Descriptor Tampering Via Sc.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications to allow access to a service from a suspicious trustee. This can be used to override access restrictions set by previous ACLs.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Tamper Windows Defender - ScriptBlockLogging
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects PowerShell scripts attempting to disable scheduled scanning and other parts of Windows Defender ATP or set default actions to allow.
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: frack113, elhoim, Tim Shelton (fps, alias support), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Change PowerShell Policies to an Insecure Level
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects changing the PowerShell script execution policy to a potentially insecure level using the "-ExecutionPolicy" flag.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Suspicious DNS Query for IP Lookup Service APIs
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects DNS queries for IP lookup services such as "api.ipify.org" originating from a non browser process.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Service Security Descriptor Tampering Via Sc.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detection of sc.exe utility adding a new service with special permission which hides that service.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Suspicious Network Connection to IP Lookup Service APIs
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects external IP address lookups by non-browser processes via services such as "api.ipify.org". This could be indicative of potential post compromise internet test activity.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Sysmon File Executable Creation Detected
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description:
Detects Portable Executable (PE) files creation events logged by Sysmon in paths monitored by the used Sysmon configuration.
This is a high-value detection for catching unauthorized or suspicious executable drops.
Alert volume and scope depend entirely on which paths or files are monitored in the Sysmon config.
A high noise level or hits from known-legitimate software are a strong signal that the Sysmon configuration is too permissive, not that the detection itself is wrong and probably needs to be tuned to a more restrictive set of paths or files.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: CurrentVersion Autorun Keys Modification
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Service StartupType Change Via Sc.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detect the use of "sc.exe" to change the startup type of a service to "disabled" or "demand"

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Suspicious File Access to Browser Credential Storage
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description:
Detects file access to browser credential storage paths by non-browser processes, which may indicate credential access attempts.
Adversaries may attempt to access browser credential storage to extract sensitive information such as usernames and passwords or cookies.
This behavior is often commonly observed in credential stealing malware.
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: frack113, X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems), Parth-FourCore

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Non Interactive PowerShell Process Spawned
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects non-interactive PowerShell activity by looking at the "powershell" process with a non-user GUI process such as "explorer.exe" as a parent.

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Browser Execution In Headless Mode
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects execution of Chromium based browser in headless mode

sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Stop Windows Service Via Sc.EXE
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects the stopping of a Windows service via the "sc.exe" utility
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Jakob Weinzettl, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
